notes:
# Watch the meeting from your phone {eye}
A phone that is allowed to watch can now see the meeting while it is
being recorded, not only hear it. Tap the picture to fill the screen and
turn the phone for a bigger one, and when somebody shares their screen
the view follows it.

---

Everything else in this release:

- The Stop button on this Mac says "Stopping…" when a recording is
  stopped from a phone, not only when you stop it here.
- This Mac now tells you when a scheduled recording starts, finishes, or
  cannot run at all — and Settings › Alerts says why macOS hides those
  while your screen is being shared.
- Live access you switch on for a phone stays on. It could be lost a
  second later while that phone was asking the Mac for its status.
- A recording no longer disappears from the app while it is still
  running.
